actions.reason: K4_C0002 has interpretable biology (VHL-depleted WXS profile; oxidative-phosphorylation-up RNA program), but its exact-set membership is broadly unsupported: all four native views show negative silhouettes (CT -0.024, RNA -0.074, WSI -0.075, WXS -0.074) with high negative fractions (0.52-0.90), meaning patients are on average closer to a competing label than to their own. Its boundaries to neighbors are weak or merge-compatible: K4_C0002-K4_C0003 shows only weak-to-moderate coherent separation (three of four views marginal, silhouettes 0.052-0.063) with a union eigengap dominated by k=2, and K4_C0002-K4_C0001 shows only weak coherent support (silhouettes 0.043-0.184, negative fractions 17-39%) with a union eigengap dominated by k=2. Candidate-specific confounder associations survive correction for tissue source site, CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel, scanner model, slice thickness, and z-spacing, so measured technical/acquisition factors remain plausible alternative explanations for membership. No supported split (set-level screen dominated by k=1, no coherent subdivision) or merge is available, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue independence. Biology alone does not establish subtype validity.

K4_C0003 has interpretable biology (BAP1-enriched WXS profile; immune/inflammatory-activated RNA program), but its exact-set membership is conflicting: CT (0.039) and RNA (0.125) show positive contrasts while WSI (-0.063) and WXS (-0.140) are negative with negative fractions of 0.65, so the current membership is not coherently represented. Its boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K4_C0002-K4_C0003 shows only weak-to-moderate coherent separation with a union eigengap dominated by k=2, and K4_C0003-K4_C0004 shows weak-to-moderate support (WSI negative fraction 0.394) with a union eigengap dominated by k=2. Candidate-specific confounder associations survive correction for tissue source site, slice thickness, and z-spacing, so measured site/acquisition factors remain plausible alternative explanations. No supported split (set-level screen dominated by k=1) or merge is available, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue independence. Biology alone does not establish subtype validity.

K4_C0004 has interpretable biology (driver-panel-level VHL-enriched/PBRM1-depleted WXS profile, no gene surviving global FDR; mesenchymal/proliferative RNA program), but its exact-set membership is conflicting: WXS shows a strong positive silhouette (0.811) while RNA (-0.062) and WSI (-0.025) are negative and CT only marginal (0.023), so membership is not coherently represented. Its boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K4_C0001-K4_C0004 shows conflicting cross-modal evidence (CT negative -0.027 vs WXS strongly positive 0.315) with a union eigengap dominated by k=1 (merge-compatible), and K4_C0003-K4_C0004 shows weak-to-moderate support with a union eigengap dominated by k=2. The set is the smallest (n=13), limiting precision, and no feasible k>=2 subdivision is reported. No supported split or merge is available, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue independence. Biology alone does not establish subtype validity.

K4_C0001 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: strong PBRM1 enrichment surviving global FDR with driver-panel-level VHL enrichment and BAP1 depletion, and a coherent transcriptomic program (oxidative-phosphorylation down-shift with coordinated immune/inflammatory suppression, all q=0.001-0.008). Its membership is supported against its decision-relevant neighbors: the K4_C0001-K4_C0002 boundary shows coherent positive cross-modal contrast (silhouettes 0.043-0.184, WXS strongest) with high two-way spectral agreement (ARI 0.781) and within-side affinity (0.499) exceeding between-side (0.161), and the K4_C0001-K4_C0004 boundary shows perfect two-way spectral agreement (ARI 1.0) with within-side affinity (0.486) exceeding between-side (0.171). No candidate-specific confounder association survives correction (tissue source site q=0.117, CT manufacturer q=0.054), so measured technical factors remain only weakly plausible alternatives. The set-level structural screen is dominated by k=1 with no coherent subdivision, and no supported split or merge is available. The CT-negative silhouette (-0.094) is a noted limitation but does not overturn the coherent multi-view boundary and membership evidence.
